non_claims: n=18. The Wilson intervals overlap unless the change is large; this is an indication, not a rate.
The normaliser computes nothing. It rewrites the question into the shape the corpus uses, so any gain is the model answering a question it was trained on the form of.
A question the model gets wrong in the trained format stays wrong.
These questions were written by hand to probe known failure modes, so they are not a random sample of what a user would ask.
